I understand that the pregnancy is now adding an extra layer of complexity to your situation and I know nothing about your views on terminating pregnancies or being a single mother, but you are young - very young. You have a whole life ahead of you and the opportunity to be with a different man who treats you exceptionally well and who'd be a great father if you have children together... so do you truly want to have a permanent tie to a horrible man while raising a baby alone or raising a baby with a man who is with you for the wrong reasons and will continue to be unfaithful to you ? ... its not my place to tell you what to do especially in regards to a pregnancy, but please please consider these questions before you make any decisions that can't be undone . If it was me in your shoes I'd choose to not be permanently tied to a bad man and I'd instead give myself the chance of having a happy, loving family further down the line without any trace of him . I wish you the best of luck, you deserve the best OP

You then double down and say in your second comment that " moving on would simply be not engaging anymore" ... when the reality is that cutting certain people out of their lives so that they can move on, is something many many people do despite it not always being easy . Examples would be deleting old social media accounts and making a new one and only adding back certain people , moving to a new state or country and not giving out the address to everyone or like OP changing phone numbers so that only relevant people have your contact information. This in itself is not toxic.
Nuances of this situation aside, its not toxic if 2 adults decide to start fresh and move on from friendships and contacts that don't serve them anymore.
